name: qlrisk_price_interest_rate_cap
title: Price a InterestRateCap
description: Price one qlrisk InterestRateCap (Interest Rate Cap - series of caplets; interest_rate, interest_rate): NPV in the trade currency and the reporting currency, pricing components, analytic Greeks where the pricer gives them, and optional cash flows. Inputs are this product's fields only; required: notional, strike (maturity_date or tenor_years). Market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today; override curves, spots and vols, or apply shocks, with market_data as in qlrisk_price_trades. For a book of several products use qlrisk_price_trades. Example: {"notional": 1000000, "tenor_years": 5, "strike": 0.04}.
